hero.title: Angel Curtido builds software companies use every day
hero.description: Systems Analysis graduate and full-stack developer. I design interfaces with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, and build desktop, web, mobile systems and backends with .NET, Node.js, and PHP/Laravel. My latest project is InventarioFácil, my own platform with a web app, a Google Play app, a website and a YouTube channel, alongside a credit sales system in active production across 15 branches of a real business.

ecommerce.title: Ecommerce
ecommerce.description: An e-commerce system with an admin panel built with Next.js and Node.js. It’s a personal project by Ángel Curtido, a Systems Analysis graduate and full-stack developer. The app is built from scratch with a custom design, is fully responsive, and uses MySQL. This project is part of my professional portfolio, showcasing my ability to design, implement, and deploy a modern online store that manages the entire purchase flow, plus a complete admin panel for managing products, orders, and users.

inventory.title: InventorySys
inventory.description: A desktop application for inventory management, built with Electron, Vite, React, and TypeScript on the frontend, and Node.js with Express and MySQL on the backend. It implements secure authentication with JWT and cookies, provides a modern UI with data visualization via charts and maps, generates PDF reports, and sends email notifications. It’s a cross-platform solution (Windows, macOS, Linux) designed to optimize inventory operations with automated backups and scheduled tasks.

portfolio.title: Personal Portfolio
portfolio.description: A web app showcasing my professional portfolio, highlighting my projects and skills as a full-stack developer. Built with Vite, React, and TypeScript, it includes an interactive technologies carousel using React Slick and a modern design with Tailwind CSS. The app is fully responsive and optimized to provide a smooth experience across mobile and desktop. It includes sections for projects, technologies, and contact, with a focus on usability and visual design.

credisoft.title: ElectroMar / CrediSoft — Credit Sales System
credisoft.description: Custom-built desktop system for Credimar S.A., an appliance retailer with 15 branches in Paraguay. Built with C#/.NET 8 (WPF) and SQL Server, it manages the full credit and cash sales cycle: applications, installment collection, adjustments and Inforconf integration, per-branch cash register, purchases and inter-branch transfers, credit-note discounts, PDF reporting, and cross-branch sync via Cloudflare Tunnel. Freelance project in active production since 2026, successfully deployed and used daily by staff across all 15 branches.

kontrolx.title: InventarioFácil / KontrolX — Management Platform with AI
kontrolx.meta: Web + Google Play app + Website + YouTube · Own product
kontrolx.description: Sales, purchasing, inventory and cash platform for retailers, with a web app, a mobile app published on Google Play and a multi-account backend of my own (Node.js, Express, MySQL). It covers cash and credit sales with installment collection, batches and expiry alerts, live cash registers per employee, per-module permissions, licenses with extensions, promotions, a flyer generator and an AI assistant that logs income and expenses from natural-language messages and loads products and invoices from a photo. It also has a website, a scheduled blog and a YouTube channel with tutorial videos.

midespensa.title: Mi Despensa — Free management app
midespensa.description: Free version of my management platform for small shops, live at midespensa.shop. A web app built with React, TypeScript and Vite, with Google sign-in, a reduced menu, a mobile-friendly interface and its own visual identity. It shares the backend (Node.js, Express, MySQL) with the paid system, where the free-plan limits are enforced.
